thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER P0: Canary deploy for inference-runtime (v3) triggered widespread CrashLoopBackOffs and 5xxs in eu-west-1. Autoscaler flipping between scale up/down. Detected at 2026-03-17T10:12:56Z (root).

mira: I'm taking this — mira here, on-call. Pausing the rollout and notifying SRE. @josh, which manifests changed in this deploy?

josh: I kicked the deploy earlier. Changes: HPA behavior policy added, targetCPU 50, and sidecar logging injection by label. Also bumped image tag inference:v3. Looking at pod logs now.

sam: Seeing repeated readiness failures: `/health` returns 500 after init. Containers OOMKilled with `failed to allocate KV cache` on heavy seqs. 5xx spike on generate endpoints (~22%).

lee: Customer-impact: top EU customers experiencing ~20% error rate on /v1/generate. Support already getting tickets from two accounts.

mira: Action plan (short): 1) stop sending traffic to canary 2) toggle feature flag kill-switch if needed 3) rollback the release 4) mitigate HPA aggressive scale-down 5) confirm node drains status.

devbot: Runbook excerpt: To pause rollout/kill canary traffic: `kubectl scale deployment inference-runtime-canary --replicas=0 -n prod`
To rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime -n prod --to-revision=42`
To set HPA safe state: `kubectl patch hpa inference-runtime -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3,"behavior":null}}'`

josh: I toggled LaunchDarkly flag `ff_infer_v3` to OFF just now — can someone confirm traffic reduction? Also I can apply HPA patch if needed.

mira: @sam I'll hand off active pager to you in 2. Can you perform the rollback and watch pods?

sam: On it. Running: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime -n prod --to-revision=42`
...
sam: Rollback started, old ReplicaSets scaling up. Watching events. New pods still hit OOM on node ip-10-0-5-12; looks like a node-level memory pressure + kubelet eviction (node was being drained earlier by pipeline).

sam: `kubectl describe node ip-10-0-5-12` shows memoryPressure and several evictions. Need to halt any automated drains targeting that node.

mira: Abort any ongoing drain. @josh can you revert the mutating webhook label that injected the sidecar? That might be increasing memory footprint per pod.

josh: Reverting label now. `kubectl label namespace prod sidecar-inject- -` applied. Also patching HPA: `kubectl patch hpa inference-runtime -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3,"behavior":null}}'`

josh: Patch applied. HPA minReplicas=3 and behavior removed. Metric server shows scaling stabilizing.

devbot: Incident note: feature flag `ff_infer_v3` toggled OFF, rollout paused, rolling-undo executed, HPA patched, sidecar injection reverted.

sam: Error rate dropping: 5xx from 22% -> 3% over 8 minutes. Latency back to normal for most customers. Keeping monitoring for 30m.

lee: Drafting customer-facing note now. Will call out temporary degraded service and that a rollback and autoscaler settings were applied.

carol (pm): We should escalate to postmortem. Assigning owners: josh = deploy/HPA changes, sam = on-call remediation and node-drain policy, mira = incident lead + comms.

mira: Agreed. After stabilization, we'll run a full postmortem. Sam — you own the incident timeline and mitigation steps. Josh — please open PR to revert HPA behavior change and add canary load test for sidecar memory.

sam: Acknowledged. I'll keep the channel open and update status to P0-acknowledged in 15.

josh: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident cleared from active pager list — follow-ups required: postmortem, canary test coverage, HPA policy review. :white_check_mark:
